text:
alex: Quick PSA — cutoff for this sprint's release notes is 11:00 PT tomorrow. Please paste one-liners into the keep-a-changelog template before then. :alarm_clock:

mira: Got it. Small ask — can we standardize the component tag format? I'm seeing a mix of `eng-runtime` and `runtime` in entries.

sam: yes please use `component: runtime` format (lowercase, no hyphen). That's what the release script expects for grouping.

jen: Heads-up: if you're carrying entries from a backport branch, add `backport: <branch>` on a new line so QA knows the origin.

alex: Good call. Short example (copy into your entry):
```
- component: runtime
  change: Fix KV cache eviction causing OOM on long context
  author: jen
  backport: release/1.4.x
```

mira: Also please keep the one-liners <120 chars and avoid implementation details. We want user-facing impact only.

sam: @alex one more — the script rejects entries missing the `component:` key. Could we add a lint step to CI to catch this earlier? :thinking_face:

alex: I'll add a quick preflight job for the changelog repo to validate keys. Won't block merges for now, just warn.

release-bot: NOTE: upcoming automated bump will run after cutoff. If you need a last-minute rollback plan, please ping ops.

jen: For branch swaps: if you switch from `main` to a release branch after adding entries, please update the `backport:` line or refile the entry to the release keep-a-changelog file.

mira: tiny nit — emoji usage in entries is fine but keep it minimal. Using :sparkles: in feature one-liners is okay but don't rely on emoji for meaning.

sam: leaving a quick checklist here so people can copy: 
- one-liner under 120 chars
- include `component:`
- add `backport:` if not on main
- no sensitive/internal-only details
- include author handle

alex: thanks everyone — will push the preflight lint and a short example file to the template dir before EOD. If you see any entries that don't match, please edit the keep-a-changelog PR rather than posting long threads here. :pray:
